reveal.art_alpha: straight alpha; exact coverage comes from artwork, never from mask alone
reveal.path_geometry_format: polyline; ordered numeric [x,y] points in component-local coordinates
reveal.mask_authority: Masks are the actual two-dimensional growth fields; paths describe their axes or radial trajectories. Do not convert every path into a single global scan.
reveal.equation: arrival=min(enabled0 ? start0+u*stroke_seconds : INF, enabled1 ? start1+(1-u)*stroke_seconds : INF); visibility=smoothstep(0,soft_front_seconds,clock-arrival); output_alpha=art_alpha*visibility
reveal.zero_visibility: clock <= earliest enabled arrival gives zero; layer_enabled=false gives zero
reveal.merge: One material per component; minimum arrival, not additive alpha and not duplicated sprites.

growth_sequencing.precondition: A valid placement has already been accepted by gameplay; renderer never changes its cells or symmetry state.
growth_sequencing.previous_animation_policy: Before planning a new placement, settle still-valid preceding visual work to its target. Do not block the new logical placement or restart completed work.
growth_sequencing.target_diff: Derive desired components from after_board. Preserve every already-visible component with the same key. Schedule only additions. Remove invalid keys on reconciliation.

external_sources.test: At least one new cell has an orthogonal before_board neighbor of equal logical color.
external_sources.source_nodes: Centers of all such adjacent existing cells, time 0.
external_sources.routing_graph: New-cell centers plus touching existing centers; edges are only new-new and new-existing same-color orthogonal pairs. Old-old connections are already complete, not replayed.
external_sources.algorithm: multi-source Dijkstra; deterministic ties use (arrival,row,column), edges N,E,S,W
external_sources.half_arm_source_times: For directed half-arm in owner A toward B: start0=t[A], start1=t[B]+0.1; stroke_seconds=0.1. Here u=0 is A center, u=1 is shared edge.
external_sources.branching: All available outgoing target arms start when their center is reached; do not wait for the bud/details to finish.
external_sources.details: For attachment u, evaluate the parent half-arm earliest arrival at u; add 0.08 seconds, then reveal the detail forward over 0.16 seconds.

without_external_source.half_arm_source_times: start0=0.10, start1=0.20, stroke_seconds=0.10 for both halves of every internal edge
without_external_source.routing: All buds are simultaneous; all valid internal edges are bidirectional. No arbitrary single seed and no growth to an unconnected border.

front_completion.complete_at: max_u in [0,1] of earliest arrival + soft_front_seconds; forward-only start0+stroke_seconds+soft_front_seconds; reverse-only start1+stroke_seconds+soft_front_seconds
front_completion.finalize: Set force_complete once, unregister from active clock updates; keep artwork permanent.

circle_event.candidate_origins: For each changed cell p, test p-(0,0), p-(1,0), p-(0,1), p-(1,1); on reset/load scan all valid origins.
circle_event.required_occupancy: All four cells exist and have the same authoritative color ID. Piece identity is irrelevant.
circle_event.required_visible_edges: Eight internal half-arms along the four perimeter edges are complete.
circle_event.event_time: max completion time of those eight half-arms, counting settled components as already complete.

union_event.predicate: Same color and overlap/positive-length edge adjacency of 2x2 footprints.
union_event.detection: Detect target immediately; creation waits for visual dependencies.
union_event.ready_time: max(fringe completion and lobe completion for both colonies); finishing glaze may overlap union growth.
union_event.field: Two enabled fronts with start0=start1=ready_time and stroke_seconds=0.76; resulting growth-front duration is 0.38 before soft tail.
union_event.deduplication: Exactly one union component per sorted colony pair.

growth_sequencing.all_done: Every target component is full and every active event is retired. No mandatory wait or gameplay gate.

components_bottom_to_top: existing four cores and internal connection arms
landmark.external_port_rule: Add ordinary independently growing arms in the relevant constituent cell only when its outside neighbor has the same color; place below the colony layers. Do not prepaint all external arms.
landmark.eligibility: any same-color completed 2x2 circle, including overlapping circles
landmark.default_component_rotation: Keep colony body at 0 degrees for stable lobe arrangement; its port availability is supplied by ordinary cell components underneath.

formation_stages.components: eight ordinary internal half-arms plus four existing cores

landmark.neighbor_behavior: Retain identity and layers; add independently owned union shelf overlays.

reef_unions.adjacency_equation: (abs(dx)<2 and abs(dy)<2 and (dx,dy)!=(0,0)) or (abs(dx)==2 and abs(dy)<2) or (abs(dy)==2 and abs(dx)<2)
reef_unions.excluded: different logical colors; footprint corner-only contacts at (±2,±2); separated footprints
reef_unions.matching: For each layout in listed order, rotate its delta k=0..3; accept actual delta equal to rotated delta or its negation. Choose first match.
reef_unions.placement: Rotate artwork and mask together about canonical canvas center. Sprite position is the center of the union bounding box of both 2x2 board footprints. Odd quarter-turns swap width/height. No stretch or independent UV rotation.
reef_unions.draw_order: Stable creation ordinal, then sorted pair key; later unions overlay earlier ones without deleting them.

rendering.technique: Persistent independently revealable Sprite2D layers; supplied mask + earliest-arrival shader.
rendering.theme_scale: display_cell_px/256; use one uniformly scaled ThemeSpace Node2D

layer_buckets.name: Colonies
layer_buckets.within: feature creation ordinal; each feature fringe then lobes then finish

rendering.mutable_material_policy: Independent ShaderMaterial for each active component; share Shader and Texture2D resources, not changing uniform state.
rendering.completed_material_policy: Full ordinary sprites in an unlit board, or a shared unshaded completed material; never repeatedly rebuild finished references.
rendering.blending: straight alpha / blend_mix; do not add growth fronts
rendering.clock: CPU placement-relative clock advanced by delta; manual pause, no shader TIME
rendering.android: Update active instances only; reuse finished sprites and cache textures; profile dense 11x11 boards on device. Do not deploy source sheets, masters or review images as runtime textures.

separation.logical_board: Authoritative occupancy, colors, move validation and symmetry; never modified by renderer.
separation.target_visuals: Desired component keys, topology masks, colony origins and union pairs derived from current board.
separation.visible_components: Persistent nodes, completion flags, stable creation ordinals and current appearance.
separation.active_growth: Front starts, stroke times, dependencies and board revision tokens.

state_management.ordering: Allocate monotonically increasing feature ordinals when first scheduled; simultaneous discoveries sorted by (row,column,color) for colonies and sorted pair keys for unions. Preserve ordinals of surviving keys.
state_management.placement: Settle previous valid animations; commit logic in existing game; diff target and append additions. A caller may commit before notification, provided before_board is supplied.
state_management.undo: Use the board restored by existing undo. Cancel pending work with a new generation token. Remove only invalid keys, preserve survivors and ordinals, and settle valid survivors. Restore ordinals from visual history if available; cold reconstruction otherwise uses documented canonical order.
state_management.deletion: Recompute affected cell masks and circles; remove obsolete arms/details, invalid colonies and incident unions. Surviving underlying layers become visible. Do not remove unrelated neighboring artwork.
state_management.reset: Cancel and detach all active callbacks, increment generation token, clear visual registries, derive fresh target from actual reset board; show its starting core from the ordinary core asset.
state_management.load: Reconstruct full target from saved logical board; settle it without inventing placement animations. Use saved feature order if available, otherwise canonical row/column/color order.
state_management.interruption: Set all still-valid components force_complete; cancel dependency callbacks; leave exact target image. For app pause suspend the CPU clock; for discarded scene cancel and free nodes.
state_management.stale_callback_rule: Every scheduled operation carries generation/revision; discard if invalidated or its component key is no longer in target.
